about_the_game:
Killer Situation is a short stealth/action horror game set on a cold winter night just days before Christmas. You play as Rachel Dunn — a young enthusiastic scientist who, after uncovering a disturbing truth about the people she works for, has taken extreme precautions to protect herself in case things go wrong. Isolated and paranoid, she’s turned her home into a high-security fortress - Bulletproof windows, Steel-reinforced doors, External surveillance, Smart home control.

No one can get in without access - or out...

Rachel wakes from a nap after a long shift to the sound of a car pulling up outside her home. A mysterious man in a mask stands at her front door - suddenly her smart locks disengage. Her smart security system has been hijacked, and the infamous 1980s serial killer has just been let inside.

The "Horse Mask Killer" was last seen in 1985, and no one has heard from him since... until now.

For reasons unknown, he’s come out of retirement - just for Rachel.

With no weapons, no help, and no control over her own house, Rachel must find and use whatever she can to escape — or die trying.

Features:

  • Short, Focused Horror – Built for a single-session experience (30–60 minutes).

  • Intense Stealth/Action Gameplay – Run, hide, and use the environment to your advantage.

  • Creative Survival – Use anything in smart ways to evade the killer and escape.

  • No Hand-Holding – Trust your instincts. Anything could work.

  • Dynamic Replayability – Puzzles, item locations, and interactions are randomized each run.

  • Multiple Endings – Choose your way out of the house — or take a final stand to make things right.

  • Atmospheric Setting – A realistic, modern smart home filled with places to hide and tools to use — if you’re quick enough.

content_descriptors.notes: Frequent Violence or Gore, General Mature Content

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 or AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 560
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Targetting 1080p@ low settings 60 fps
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 or AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 Super or AMD Radeon RX 590
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Targetting 1080p@ high settings 60 fps

short_description: On a snowy night just before Christmas, your smart home is breached. A serial killer has come for you - and you are trapped with him in your own house. Outsmart, hide, or fight your way out in this short, intense horror experience.
